messages.subject: App runs locally in RStudio/Browser, Fails shinyapps.io
parts:
I have been trying to update an app that runs fine in RStudio and a local web browser, but fails with deployment to shinayappas.io here:

https://insilico.shinyapps.io/visreg-app/

The app deploys but the screen goes gray after a few seconds without any error indication in the logs.
